about_the_game:
Step into the infinite with Weightless, the first-ever music experience created specifically for cinematic Six-Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) VR. Written by Grammy and Academy Award winning songwriter Diane Warren and performed by pop sensation Arilena Ara, this revolutionary experience takes you beyond the limits of reality.

Set against a mesmerizing cosmic backdrop, Weightless takes you on an emotional voyage from the Big Bang to the birth of galaxies, all synchronized to the soaring melodies of Arilena Ara’s performance. Each moment unfolds with breathtaking visuals and a dynamic perspective, allowing you to explore the cosmos like never before.

We recommend watching the experience while standing up, to fully enjoy the choreography and the surroundings.

Key Features

  • First-of-its-kind VR music experience: a new way to feel music, designed exclusively for immersive virtual reality.

  • Freedom of perspective: move freely within space, discovering hidden details and breathtaking celestial formations.

  • Stunning cosmic visuals: witness the creation of the universe, from stardust to supernovas, in a journey of sight and sound.

Trigger Warning
Weightless contains artistic depictions of nudity (female body), which may not be suitable for all audiences. Parental guidance is recommended for younger audiences.

Awards
The V-Nova PresenZ format has won three Lumiere Awards from Hollywood’s Advanced Imaging Society, recognizing its groundbreaking visual fidelity and its potential to unlock the future of immersive VR storytelling.

For ImmersiX manual, contact form, and privacy policy, please refer to the ‘View the Manual’ link on the ImmersiX App page.
